Agent Name: Orchestrator
Step Number: 24
Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator asserted, as a “given or verified fact,” that the first National Geographic short on YouTube is “Human Origins 101” (Sep 14, 2018) without any verification. This incorrect assumption redirected the entire search toward identifying “#9” within that unrelated video and then finding its length on the Monterey Bay Aquarium site, causing looping behavior and culminating in the wrong final answer.
